notes:
The second pages.dev address can now be switched on from the panel. 4.9.0 shipped that feature with no way to reach it: the setting was read from a Worker variable that was not in the panel, not documented, and not set by the installer bot. It is now a field in Settings under System extras, in English, Russian and Farsi, and findable from the panel search.

One thing still has to be done by hand, and the panel says so: create the Pages project yourself and bind it to this panel's own D1 database and KV namespace. Nova refuses to deploy to a project bound to anything else, because a copy that cannot read your data would come up unclaimed on a public address and the first visitor could take it.

Everything else is unchanged from 4.9.0.
